events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Go to Grand Haven first.** Rating: **3 (good)**, with low confidence because the report is six days old.
- **Fish 120-220 ft of water, with lines about 60-120 ft down.** Use yellow or green meat rigs and green flies, and add glow spoons in low light.
- **St. Joseph is second, rated 2 (average).** Fish about 100 ft of water, where the last boat report found a few fish.
- **Skip South Haven and Muskegon for salmon this week.** South Haven is rated 1 (below average) and Muskegon is rated 1 (below average).

Ratings for this week:
- Grand Haven: 3 (good)
- St. Joseph: 2 (average)
- South Haven: 1 (below average)
- Muskegon: 1 (below average)

## Why

- **Grand Haven ranks first because its latest boat report was rated good.** The July 19 Grand Haven report said anglers were catching salmon and trout 65 to 120 feet down in 130 to 220 feet of water (Grand Haven, 2023-07-19).
- **Muskegon is rated lower because its boat report the same week was "hit or miss."** That report said the best action was 60 to 100 feet down in 110 to 200 feet of water (Muskegon, 2023-07-19).
- **St. Joseph is rated average because its boat report said the fishing was slowing.** Anglers caught a few fish at 100 feet, but the report said decent numbers were still being caught (St. Joseph, 2023-07-19).
- **South Haven is rated below average because its boat report did not name salmon.** Anglers reported lake trout with some coho and steelhead mixed in, and the report rated the fishing 1 (South Haven, 2023-07-19).
- **I'd expect the fish to stay deep because the water is warm.** Surface water is about 71 to 73 F, well above the 52 to 58 F range that Chinook and coho prefer (NY DEC guidance), so fish hold deeper where it is cooler.

## Evidence

**Recent reports** (newest is 2023-07-19, six days old)
- Grand Haven, boat: "Boat anglers were catching a mix of salmon and trout 65 to 120 feet down in 130 to 220 feet of water… Yellow and green meat rigs were working well along with green flies." Rated 3. A separate Chinook entry noted glow spoons in low light, not rated (Grand Haven, 2023-07-19).
- Muskegon, boat: "Boat anglers were finding the salmon action to be hit or miss… The best action was 60 to 100 feet down in 110 to 200 feet of water." Rated 1 (Muskegon, 2023-07-19).
- St. Joseph, boat: "Boat anglers targeting salmon were catching a few fish in 100 feet of water… The fishing was slowing down." Rated 2 (St. Joseph, 2023-07-19).
- South Haven, boat: "The fish were mostly lake trout with some coho and steelhead mixed in." Rated 1 (South Haven, 2023-07-19).
- The July 5 reports were also mostly fair to average, with South Haven rated 1 and St. Joseph rated 2 (South Haven and St. Joseph, 2023-07-05).

**Past seasons** (similar weeks with surface water near 72 F, from the history search)
- Early August 2022 at Muskegon and Grand Haven was rated 2 to 3 for boats. Anglers fished 120 to 250 ft of water, 65 to 140 ft down, on glow spoons, meat rigs and green or white flies (Grand Haven and Muskegon, 2022-08-03).
- Mid-July 2022 at Grand Haven and Muskegon was slow (rated 0), after strong upwelling winds (Grand Haven and Muskegon, 2022-07-14). This is history, not this week.

**Conditions now** (from a backtest summary covering the week before 2023-07-25, since live data was unavailable)
- Buoy surface water: St. Joseph 73 F (+3 F over the week), South Haven 73 F (+1 F), Grand Haven 71 F (flat), Muskegon 71 F (flat).
- Satellite surface water near the piers: St. Joseph 73 F, South Haven 73 F, Grand Haven 72 F, Muskegon 72 F. Satellite values are approximate.
- Wind that week averaged 6 to 8 mph, with gusts of 27 to 33 mph at all four ports. Gusts that high are rough for a small boat.
- Upwelling-favoring wind (north to east, 8+ mph) totaled 30 hours at St. Joseph and 29 at South Haven, but only 1 hour in the last three days at each. Grand Haven had 14 hours and Muskegon 11, with none in the last three days.

## Caveats

- **The reports are old.** The newest is from July 19, six days before today, and the ratings reflect that week's conditions. Check the next DNR bulletin before you go.
- **The conditions data is a backtest summary, not live.** The water and wind figures describe the week before July 25, and I did not get a modeled cold-layer depth for this week.
- **The ratings are thin.** Grand Haven's rating rests on one good report. Its neighbor, Muskegon, reported the same week as "hit or miss."
- **Gusts are the safety issue.** Gusts up to 30+ mph were recorded at all four ports. Check the forecast, and consider the pier if winds are strong.

## Sources

- Grand Haven, Muskegon, St. Joseph and South Haven, July 19, 2023 report: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/366250d
- South Haven, St. Joseph and others, July 5, 2023 report: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/363ad03
- Grand Haven and Muskegon, August 3, 2022 report (history): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3268d0b
